Actions.Name: Add Meat Cleaver to Inventory
Actions.Description: Gives you the Meat Cleaver tool used by this mod's animal slaughtering feature.

Actions.Name: Add Insemination Syringe to Inventory
Actions.Description: Gives you the Insemination Syringe tool for breeding animals.

Actions.Name: Add Feeding Basket to Inventory
Actions.Description: Gives you the Feeding Basket tool for hand-feeding animals.

Actions.Name: Toggle Automate Overlay
Actions.Description: Shows the connection lines between machines and chests that Automate is linking.

Actions.Name: Toggle Gate Overlay
Actions.Description: Shows which gates are set to open/close automatically.

Actions.Name: Hide Overlay While Scrolling
Actions.Description: Hold to temporarily hide the gate overlay, e.g. while scrolling the toolbar.

Actions.Name: Mark Gate as Ignored
Actions.Description: Click a gate (with the overlay open) to exclude it from automatic behavior.

Actions.Name: Un-ignore Gate
Actions.Description: Click an ignored gate to restore its automatic behavior.

Actions.Name: Increase Auto-Close Delay
Actions.Description: Numpad +. Increases how long a gate waits before auto-closing.

Actions.Name: Decrease Auto-Close Delay
Actions.Description: Numpad -. Decreases how long a gate waits before auto-closing.

Actions.Name: Toggle Debug Overlay
Actions.Description: Shows beehouse range and debug info.

Actions.Name: Suppress Better Crafting Menu
Actions.Description: Hold while opening the crafting menu to get the vanilla menu instead.

Actions.Name: Crafting Modifier
Actions.Description: Hold to enable a secondary action (e.g. bulk craft) on click.

Actions.Name: Favorite Recipe
Actions.Description: Marks the highlighted recipe as a favorite for quick access.

Actions.Name: Bulk Craft
Actions.Description: Crafts the maximum possible quantity of the selected recipe.

Actions.Name: Search Recipes
Actions.Description: Opens the recipe search box.

Actions.Name: Open Cheats Menu
Actions.Description: Opens the CJB Cheats Menu.

Actions.Name: Reload Cheats Config
Actions.Description: Reloads the cheats configuration from disk.

Actions.Name: Freeze Time
Actions.Description: Toggles freezing the in-game clock.

Actions.Name: Grow Nearby Tree
Actions.Description: Instantly grows the tree under your cursor.

Actions.Name: Grow Nearby Crops
Actions.Description: Instantly grows the crops under your cursor.

Actions.Name: Toggle Orb of Tides
Actions.Description: Toggles the Orb of the Tides feature for the Cape Stardew content pack.

Actions.Name: Toggle Orb of Tides (Controller)
Actions.Description: Controller-bound duplicate of the Orb of the Tides toggle. NOTE: this collides with this mod's own default open-menu button - see the example-setup README.

Actions.Name: Open Chests Anywhere
Actions.Description: Opens the remote chest browser.

Actions.Name: Previous Chest
Actions.Description: Selects the previous chest in the list.

Actions.Name: Next Chest
Actions.Description: Selects the next chest in the list.

Actions.Name: Previous Category
Actions.Description: Switches to the previous chest category tab.

Actions.Name: Next Category
Actions.Description: Switches to the next chest category tab.

Actions.Name: Edit Chest
Actions.Description: Opens options to rename or categorize the selected chest.

Actions.Name: Sort Chest Items
Actions.Description: Sorts the items in the selected chest.

Actions.Name: Scroll Chests with Mouse Wheel
Actions.Description: Hold and scroll to cycle through chests.

Actions.Name: Scroll Categories with Mouse Wheel
Actions.Description: Hold and scroll to cycle through categories.

Actions.Name: Search Chests
Actions.Description: Opens the chest search box.

Actions.Name: Preview Chest in Search
Actions.Description: Hold while browsing search results to preview a chest's contents.

Actions.Name: Toggle CP Debug Overlay
Actions.Description: Shows which content patches are applied to the tile under your cursor.

Actions.Name: Debug: Previous Texture
Actions.Description: While the debug overlay is open, hold to cycle to the previous patched texture.

Actions.Name: Debug: Next Texture
Actions.Description: While the debug overlay is open, hold to cycle to the next patched texture.

Actions.Name: Open Fashion Sense Menu
Actions.Description: Opens the outfit/accessory quick menu.

Actions.Name: Pause Fast Animations
Actions.Description: Temporarily disables the animation speed-up.

Actions.Name: Open Mod Config Menu
Actions.Description: Opens the in-game settings menu for any GMCM-compatible mod.

Actions.Name: Give Item Modifier
Actions.Description: Hold while placing an item to give it instead of spending it.

Actions.Name: Favorite Item Modifier
Actions.Description: Hold to mark the selected furniture/item as a favorite.

Actions.Name: Toggle Happy Home Designer
Actions.Description: Turns the furniture placement helper on or off.

Actions.Name: Open Design Menu
Actions.Description: Opens the Happy Home Designer menu.

Actions.Name: Quick Delete Item
Actions.Description: Deletes the selected placed item.

Actions.Name: Look Up Anything
Actions.Description: Shows detailed info about whatever's under your cursor.

Actions.Name: Search Lookup Anything
Actions.Description: Opens the lookup search box.

Actions.Name: Scroll Lookup Up
Actions.Description: Scrolls the lookup popup up.

Actions.Name: Scroll Lookup Down
Actions.Description: Scrolls the lookup popup down.

Actions.Name: Lookup Page Up
Actions.Description: Jumps up a page in the lookup popup.

Actions.Name: Lookup Page Down
Actions.Description: Jumps down a page in the lookup popup.

Actions.Name: Toggle Lookup Debug Info
Actions.Description: Shows extra debug details in lookup results.

Actions.Name: Open Machine Control Panel
Actions.Description: Opens the control panel for the machine under your cursor.

Actions.Name: Select Machines
Actions.Description: Enters machine multi-select mode.

Actions.Name: Toggle Machine Overlay
Actions.Description: Shows an overlay with machine status icons.

Actions.Name: Open Full Map
Actions.Description: Opens the full-screen map showing NPC locations.

Actions.Name: Toggle Minimap
Actions.Description: Shows or hides the on-screen minimap.

Actions.Name: Show Map Tooltip
Actions.Description: Hold to show name tooltips on the map.

Actions.Name: Open Nature Encyclopedia
Actions.Description: Opens the Nature in the Valley encyclopedia menu.

Actions.Name: Expand Tractor Tool Radius
Actions.Description: Numpad +. Increases the tractor attachment's area of effect.

Actions.Name: Shrink Tractor Tool Radius
Actions.Description: Numpad -. Decreases the tractor attachment's area of effect.

Actions.Name: Toggle Crop Labels
Actions.Description: Shows or hides labels over crops in the field.

Actions.Name: Social Interaction Modifier
Actions.Description: Hold while interacting with an NPC to trigger SpaceCore's extra social interactions.

Actions.Name: Check Aquarium Donations
Actions.Description: Shows which fish you still need to donate to the aquarium.

Actions.Name: Toggle StardewUI Tracing
Actions.Description: Developer diagnostic: toggles StardewUI's performance tracing overlay.

Actions.Name: Freeze Time
Actions.Description: Pauses the in-game clock.

Actions.Name: Slow Down Time
Actions.Description: Makes in-game minutes pass more slowly.

Actions.Name: Speed Up Time
Actions.Description: Makes in-game minutes pass more quickly.

Actions.Name: Reload TimeSpeed Config
Actions.Description: Reloads TimeSpeed's settings from disk.

Actions.Name: Open To-Dew List
Actions.Description: Opens the daily to-do checklist.

Actions.Name: Open To-Dew List (Alt)
Actions.Description: Alternate binding that opens the same to-do checklist.

Actions.Name: Close To-Dew List
Actions.Description: Closes the to-do checklist using a controller button.

Actions.Name: Summon Tractor
Actions.Description: Press Backspace to call your tractor to your location.

Actions.Name: Dismiss Tractor
Actions.Description: Press Backspace while riding to send the tractor back to its garage.

Actions.Name: Trinket Interact
Actions.Description: Interacts with the active trinket's special ability.

Actions.Name: Open Trinket Inventory
Actions.Description: Opens the trinket loadout/inventory screen.

Actions.Name: Next Trinket Page
Actions.Description: Shows the next page of trinkets.

Actions.Name: Previous Trinket Page
Actions.Description: Shows the previous page of trinkets.

Actions.Name: Open Calendar
Actions.Description: Opens the calendar from anywhere.

Actions.Name: Open Quest Board
Actions.Description: Opens the quest board from anywhere.

Actions.Name: Show Single Range
Actions.Description: Hold to show the range of the item or building under your cursor.

Actions.Name: Show All Ranges
Actions.Description: Hold to show the ranges of every sprinkler/scarecrow/etc. on the farm.
